newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lung Kee Metal in 50 mln share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Lung Kee Metal in 50 mln share IPO.

text.p: Lung Kee Metal Holdings Ltd (LKMH), a unit of Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd, said on Monday it was offering 50 million shares at US$0.55 each in its Singapore initial public offering.
LKMH, which makes mould bases and trades in metals, industry oil and machinery, said in a statement it was offering 35 million new shares and the balance of 15 million shares were vendor shares.
It will place out 40 million shares at US$0.55 each and the rest will be offered to the public at the same price.
The offer represents 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital.

It expects to raise net proceeds of US$18.1 million for the construction of a factory and to establish manufacturing facilites in Guangzhou and Shanghai in China and Malaysia. It will also be used to expand an existing mould-based parts factory in China and for new machinery in Hong Kong.
The shares are offered at a forecast price earnings ratio of 7.78 times based on the financial year ending March 31, 1997.
For the six months ended September 30, 1996, LKMH recorded a net profit of Singapore $8.04 million on a turnover of S$34.29 million.
The offer for the public tranche opens on January 7 and closes on January 21.
